title: Rollaway Brainstorming v3
author: Marshall Gould
problems: Row 8 "robins start a hey - lefts in center, rights on ends - until partners meet" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey goes at least two passes before the meeting.
Row 8 "robins start a hey - lefts in center, rights on ends - until partners meet" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey needs a group of four.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
